reviewMethod.reviewer: OpenCode agent, independent manual source review
reviewMethod.method: Fetched the current Vercel Web Interface Guidelines, independently read exactly the 17 listed final source files, applied every relevant rule, and checked the approved redesign contract, semantics, focus, responsive behavior, image metadata, motion, content boundaries, and deferred minor findings. Scores and findings were authored from current source; qa.mjs only validates and consumes them.
reviewMethod.scope: Exactly the 17 listed Astro page, layout, component, and CSS files in src/

sharedFindings.summary: Concept selector has no skip link to its main content.
Concept selector has no theme-color meta matching its light background.
Concept selector headings do not use text-wrap: balance or text-pretty.
Concept selector links have no explicit hover feedback.
Interactive controls do not set touch-action: manipulation or an intentional tap-highlight color.

categoryEvidence.informationHierarchy: Image-led h1 leads a compact proof band, three pathways, numbered protocol, practitioner authority, and final state; Approach groups the model into six distinct modules.
categoryEvidence.conversionClarity: Explore the Forge Approach is the functional next step while both Book an Evaluation controls are disabled and paired with Online scheduling coming soon.
categoryEvidence.navigationFindability: Persistent semantic Home and Forge Approach links expose aria-current; planned routes remain labeled non-actions in desktop and native mobile disclosure.
categoryEvidence.trustCredibility: The page identifies Brandon Coveney, PT, DPT, OCS, Sacred Heart DPT 2018, one-on-one care, and explicit stock limitations without reviews or outcome claims.
categoryEvidence.contentClarity: Rehabilitation, Return to activity, Performance and Recover, Build, Perform provide clear parallel ways to understand the individualized progression.
categoryEvidence.mobileErgonomics: At 48rem image overlays remain readable, grids collapse to conventional one-column source order, controls retain practical height, and navigation uses native details.
categoryEvidence.interactionFeedback: Gold focus-visible and hover states, aria-current, disabled cursor, and status copy are clear; touch-action/tap-highlight are unspecified.
categoryEvidence.visualUsability: High-contrast black/ivory/gold, bounded measures, balanced condensed headings, compact proof cells, and controlled crops support scanning; clip-path animation and missing font preload are minor costs.

categoryEvidence.informationHierarchy: Editorial h1/h2 hierarchy, folios, margin notes, numbered modules, semantic lists, and an eight-link Approach index expose the reading sequence.
categoryEvidence.conversionClarity: Read the Forge Approach is consistently active while evaluation booking remains visibly disabled and explicitly unavailable.
categoryEvidence.navigationFindability: Persistent semantic navigation plus an eight-link chapter index provides direct access to every offset Approach destination.
categoryEvidence.trustCredibility: Verified credentials, one-on-one care, factual progression, and complete two-image disclosure establish trust without invented proof.
categoryEvidence.contentClarity: Premise, audiences, three stages, practitioner note, decision principles, expectations, and next step are explicit; the Approach audience module directly explains applications for active adults, athletes and weekend warriors, and strength and fitness enthusiasts.
categoryEvidence.mobileErgonomics: At 64rem navigation simplifies and at 44rem editorial grids collapse in source order, while controls retain 44px height and reading measures remain bounded.
categoryEvidence.interactionFeedback: Visible focus and hover, active-page contrast, anchor offsets, native details, disabled cursor, and scheduling status provide clear feedback; touch styling is unspecified.
categoryEvidence.visualUsability: Warm paper contrast, readable serif measure, fine rules, deliberate crops, and restrained folios create the clearest long-form reading direction.

guidelineFindings.summary: Compressed one-line FAQ markup reduces source reviewability without changing rendered semantics.

categoryEvidence.navigationFindability: Persistent semantic navigation, aria-current, mobile details, progression jump link, and return-home link are present; the jump target lacks offset.
categoryEvidence.trustCredibility: Verified credentials, one-on-one care, activity examples framed as non-promises, and complete three-image disclosure avoid fabricated proof.

categoryEvidence.visualUsability: Near-black/off-white contrast, dark native color scheme, electric-lime signals, condensed hierarchy, directional rules, and decisive documentary crops scan well; balanced heading wrapping, hero priority, and compositor-friendly motion remain minor gaps.
